Author: Ehno, AllegroVivo
Name: XIV Venue Manager Sync
Punchline: In-game companion for xivvenuemanager.com — log patron visits, sales, and services without leaving FFXIV.
Description: In-game companion for XIV Venue Manager, a venue-management platform for FFXIV player-run venues (xivvenuemanager.com). Tracks patron entry and exit at your venue, logs sales and services to your web dashboard in real time, and keeps guest lists in sync with the staff, roles, and services you configure on the website. Set up an account at xivvenuemanager.com, generate a link code from the dashboard, and enter it in this plugin's Settings tab to start syncing.
Changelog: v4.0.0: The plugin now talks to the new XIV Venue Manager system, so everyone needs to link again once. Open the dashboard (API Keys, Generate link code) and enter the code in the plugin's Settings, Account link. Old API keys no longer work. New: a setup checklist and Link current character in Settings (your own visits are not logged until your character is linked); houses, apartments and FC houses matched to your venues by address; shift prompts with Clock in and Clock out buttons, and your shift shown at any venue on the status bar; join open event shifts; reserve, lock and disable rooms; a Bans tab; your own leave reported and players already inside reported as present. Includes v3.11.1: fixed the greeter never sending welcome messages when the Status Bar display was Disabled.
